Name: createOrderSaga
Comment:
D-113: Saga state machine for the order -> stock -> payment long-running flow.

Forward path (happy path):
  1) reserveStock  - deduct inventory (or reserve) for the course.
  2) createPayment - instruct the OPM Payment middle platform to record a Payment.
  3) confirmOrder  - flip the order row from PENDING to PAID/CONFIRMED.

Compensation path (triggered when any forward step fails, replayed LIFO):
  - releaseStock   - compensate reserveStock (return reserved units).
  - refundPayment  - compensate createPayment (issue refund via OPM).
  - cancelOrder    - compensate confirmOrder (mark order CANCELLED).

AT mode is retained for short single-service transactions (see OrderServiceImpl).
Saga is preferred here because AT holds global locks for the entire long-running
flow; Saga releases each branch's local lock as soon as the branch commits and
only retains the (much cheaper) compensation contract.

States.Name: ReserveStock
States.Comment: Forward step 1: reserve stock for the course via the InventoryService.

States.Name: CreatePayment
States.Comment: Forward step 2: instruct the OPM Payment middle platform to create a Payment.

States.Name: ConfirmOrder
States.Comment: Forward step 3 (final): flip the order row PENDING -> PAID/CONFIRMED and publish domain events.

States.Name: ReleaseStock
States.Comment: Compensation for ReserveStock: release the reserved units back to inventory.

States.Name: RefundPayment
States.Comment: Compensation for CreatePayment: instruct the OPM Payment middle platform to refund.

States.Name: CancelOrder
States.Comment: Compensation for ConfirmOrder: mark the order CANCELLED and publish a cancel event.

States.Name: CompensationTrigger
States.Comment: Central compensation trigger: Seata Saga replays registered compensations LIFO.
